title: EmuCoreX NOVO EMULADOR DE PS2 PARA CELULAR ANDROID CONFIGURAÇÃO E TESTE EM JOGOS!
summary: A Portuguese EmuCoreX tour on a Poco X6 5G that connects official installation, library tools, graphics configuration and an extended gameplay segment.

blocks.text: BrunoAndroid begins at the project’s official GitHub page, installs the Android package, completes the BIOS and library onboarding, and then explores the finished home screen. The recording covers search, RetroAchievements, cheat controls, supported image formats, ISO-to-CHD conversion, cover presentation and the settings areas instead of jumping directly to a single frame-rate clip.

Testing was performed on hardware with 8 GB of RAM: a Poco X6 5G powered by the Snapdragon 7s Gen 2 and its Adreno 710 GPU. The configuration segment starts near 1:32, while gameplay begins around 6:14; those timestamps separate interface instructions from performance evidence. Because the presenter uses an early build, verify every recommendation against the current app and the specific revision of the game being tested.
